title: ICAI Announces January 2027 CA Foundation and Intermediate Exam Form Schedule
content:
# ICAI Announces January 2027 CA Foundation and Intermediate Exam Form Schedule

Ek important update hai for all CA Foundation and Intermediate aspirants! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne January 2027 examinations ke liye exam form submission schedule announce kar diya hai. This is a critical timeline, so mark your calendars.

*   **Online Application Starts:** November 3, 2026, from 10:00 AM IST.
*   **Last Date for Application (without late fee):** November 16, 2026, till 11:59 PM IST.
*   **Last Date for Application (with late fee):** November 19, 2026, till 11:59 PM IST. A late fee of ₹600 (or US $10) will be applicable.
*   **Correction Window:** November 20, 2026, to November 22, 2026.

Candidates are advised to apply online through the ICAI e-Services portal (eservices.icai.org) within the stipulated dates to avoid any last-minute hassle.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.icai.org/new_category.html?id=38308)
